sn3.24:1.6: Giving is not purely a matter of utilitarian calculation. It creates an emotional connection, which is why giving with one’s own hands is important. It’s not just about helping another; it’s also about elevating oneself.
sn3.24:1.14: Note that, while the _khattiyas_ were often said to be the warrior class, there is no difference here.
sn3.24:10.4: The Upanishads say that the thunder is the roar of Brahma. Thus it seems that, while the animist heritage of deva=sky is usually backgrounded, here it is rather more specific.
